about.title: Tradition. Strength. Champions.
about.subtitle: Kuldeep Malik Sports Academy follows the rich tradition of Indian wrestling. Here, athletes train in a traditional akhada environment with experienced coaches, strong values, and a focus on becoming better wrestlers and better individuals.

disciplineQuotes: Practice brahmacharya — make not only the body, but also the mind, invincible.
Those who bathe in water only change their clothes; those who bathe in sweat change history.
Parents are the first gurus; honouring them is true education.
Discipline is the power that turns an ordinary youth into a great pehlwan.
Where there is restraint in life, success follows in every step.
The Academy teaches not only wrestling, but also how to live life.
Before becoming a champion, first become the master of yourself.
Work so silently that victory itself becomes your introduction.
Strength of the body comes from practice; strength of the mind comes from brahmacharya.
